terra.problem: The passage says the men who sought to kill Moses are dead, not that the danger is gone. Saying it sent him running also relies on an earlier passage without a reference.
The passage does not say all danger is gone. The reference to Moses running comes from an earlier passage and needs its own reference.
The verse does not mention a horn, but it does not establish that there was no horn on the trip.
Saying Moses gets the full picture overstates what the LORD tells him in this passage.
Exodus 19:6 says ‘a holy nation,’ not ‘My holy nation.’ Also, saying a son is closer than a nation adds a comparison the text does not make.
The text does not say Zipporah moves fast or that the whole family is present at the lodging place.
The passage does not say the LORD tells Aaron to go only after the lodging-place scene. Verse 27 says He had told Aaron meanwhile.
The passage does not establish that Jethro is still in Midian at the time of the lodging-place scene.
The passage names the mountain of God as the meeting place but does not explicitly establish that Moses has not yet reached Egypt.
The passage does not say Moses left Jethro's home or that the meeting at the mountain took place on a road.
The text does not say whether anyone is surprised at the meeting.
The passage says Aaron relayed the words and Moses performed the signs, but does not say Moses performed them while Aaron was speaking.
The passage does not say Moses performed the signs while Aaron was talking.
The passage does not establish that there were no songs at the meeting; it simply does not mention them.
The passage says the people believed, but it does not explicitly say they did not ask for more signs.
